mapper.select: SELECT t.id task_id,t.tenant_id,t.adapter,t.source_system,t.connection_id,t.version, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.definition,'$.mode')) mode, CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.definition,'$.resetMappingsBeforeLoad'))='true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END reset_mappings_before_load, t.active_run_id,r.task_id run_task_id,r.tenant_id run_tenant_id, r.config_version run_config_version,r.preview run_preview,r.status run_status,r.creator actor_code FROM int_sync_task t LEFT JOIN int_sync_run r ON r.id=t.active_run_id AND r.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND r.deleted=b'0' WHERE t.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND t.id=#{query.id} AND t.deleted=b'0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,tenant_id,task_id,status,preview,deleted,read_count, SHA2(result_json,256) result_digest,SHA2(config_snapshot,256) config_digest, summary_json,create_time,update_time FROM int_sync_run WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND id=#{query.id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT * FROM int_sync_binding WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND task_id=#{query.taskId} AND object_key=#{query.object} AND source_object=#{query.sourceObject} AND deleted=b'0'
AND source_key IN #{key}
AND 1=0
ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
